subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` grow a first-class cross-channel account/profile selector for provider-backed models, and what shared contract should Discord, Telegram, and future channel pickers implement?
rationale: The lower-level auth-profile machinery exists, but the UX, precedence against `/model ...@profile`, compatibility with provider auth order, and cross-channel callback shape require maintainer product direction before implementation.

options.title: Define a shared picker contract
options.body: Add shared provider/model/profile data and active-profile display for supported channel pickers, with one tested session persistence rule.

options.title: Keep typed commands as the supported path
options.body: Document `/model ...@profile`, `/model status`, and auth-order commands as the intended account-switching flow and close or defer picker UX.

options.title: Pilot one channel first
options.body: Approve a narrower Discord or Telegram experiment while keeping the shared contract explicit enough to avoid future divergence.

recommendation.title: Define a shared picker contract
recommendation.body: Add shared provider/model/profile data and active-profile display for supported channel pickers, with one tested session persistence rule.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across shared model picker, plugin/channel boundary, and auth/session override surfaces.
